title: 海南客流涨14%：销售只涨3%到4%，人均支出为何反而降了？
speaker: Michelle Cheng

segments.en: So, for this data, it's a little bit hard to interpret, but all aggregated wise, I think
segments.zh: 所以这些数据有点难解读，但整体汇总来看，我认为

segments.en: it's still not too exciting if we combine really the recent few monks trend.
segments.zh: 如果结合近几个月的趋势，仍然不算太令人兴奋。

segments.en: Single digit growth from different sources is slightly better than only like zero to one percent retail sales growth in July, August, and consumers still spend a little bit more during the holidays, but you can see there are still very rational spending.
segments.zh: 不同来源的个位数增长，略好于七八月零售销售仅零到百分之一的增长，消费者在假期仍多花了一点钱，但可以看出支出仍然非常理性。

segments.en: For example, like high-nan traffic is up 14%, but the sales is also only up like 3, 4%.
segments.zh: 例如，海南客流增长14%，但销售仅增长约3%到4%。

segments.en: So the per has spending is actually done. And clearly all your price is very high, air fare is high.
segments.zh: 所以人均支出实际上在下降。而且很明显，机票等价格很高。

segments.en: So consumers domestically, the traffic is only like zero to one percent.
segments.zh: 所以国内客流仅增长约零到百分之一。

segments.en: So consumers choose to travel by railway, order travel methodology rather than took the air flight or even drove by themselves.
segments.zh: 所以消费者选择铁路出行，而不是坐飞机，甚至不是自驾。

segments.en: So you can still see that they want to go out, but very cautious in spending.
segments.zh: 所以仍能看出他们想出门，但在支出上非常谨慎。
